sqlite.name: books:table
sqlite.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='books' AND type='table'

sqlite.name: books.id:column
sqlite.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pragma_table_info('books') WHERE name='id' AND upper(type)='INTEGER' AND "notnull"=0 AND pk=1 AND dflt_value IS NULL

sqlite.name: books.title:column
sqlite.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pragma_table_info('books') WHERE name='title' AND upper(type)='TEXT' AND "notnull"=1 AND pk=0 AND dflt_value IS NULL

sqlite.name: books.author:column
sqlite.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pragma_table_info('books') WHERE name='author' AND upper(type)='TEXT' AND "notnull"=1 AND pk=0 AND dflt_value IS NULL

sqlite.name: books.insertion_order:column
sqlite.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pragma_table_info('books') WHERE name='insertion_order' AND upper(type)='INTEGER' AND "notnull"=1 AND pk=0 AND dflt_value IS NULL

sqlite.name: books:sqlite_autoindex_books_1
sqlite.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pragma_index_list('books') AS i WHERE i."unique"=1 AND (SELECT group_concat(name, ',') FROM (SELECT name FROM pragma_index_info(i.name) ORDER BY seqno))='insertion_order'

postgres.name: books:table
postgres.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class WHERE oid='books'::regclass AND relkind IN ('r','p')

postgres.name: books.id:column
postgres.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=current_schema() AND table_name='books' AND column_name='id' AND data_type='integer' AND is_nullable='NO' AND is_identity='YES'

postgres.name: books.id:primary-key
postgres.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conrelid='books'::regclass AND c.contype='p' AND c.convalidated AND (SELECT string_agg(a.attname, ',' ORDER BY k.n) FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum,n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.conrelid AND a.attnum=k.attnum)='id'

postgres.name: books.title:column
postgres.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=current_schema() AND table_name='books' AND column_name='title' AND data_type='text' AND is_nullable='NO' AND column_default IS NULL

postgres.name: books.author:column
postgres.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=current_schema() AND table_name='books' AND column_name='author' AND data_type='text' AND is_nullable='NO' AND column_default IS NULL

postgres.name: books.insertion_order:column
postgres.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=current_schema() AND table_name='books' AND column_name='insertion_order' AND data_type='integer' AND is_nullable='NO' AND column_default IS NULL

postgres.name: books:sqlite_autoindex_books_1
postgres.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conrelid='books'::regclass AND c.contype='u' AND c.convalidated AND (SELECT string_agg(a.attname, ',' ORDER BY k.n) FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum,n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.conrelid AND a.attnum=k.attnum)='insertion_order'
